notes.text: Whole page viewed once for layout; each supplied half viewed once line by line against both witnesses. Every token, including agreed passages, was checked. No OCR, text recognition, external research or TeX compilation was used.

34 handwritten baselines counted, including manuscript number, marginal ??, upper word addition, two gloss lines, par C5, independent cancelled fragments and the bottom short line. The main running/display sequence excluding these extra baselines has 26 lines.
Retain the unexpected comma after de in the opening paragraph. Do not repair it grammatically.
The display gloss opens a parenthesis but has no visible closing parenthesis. The long parenthesis opened in the argument closes after OK ! in the proof.
The page asserts F≤G and F≼G imply F=G; then considers a nonempty disjoint H≪G. These are transcribed as assertions, without supplying missing definitions or a proof.
The displayed H≪G plus H disjointe de G implies H=phi_F is accompanied by the H≤G′≼G argument and the C5 insertion. The subscript F is retained even though the proof later writes plain phi.
C5 support equality and support-intersection criterion are copied as written. The C6/C7 remarks are promises of later verification, not proofs checked in this pass.
No independent mathematical proof check was completed: this page does not provide the definitions of its three orders or axioms. Visual verification of formula tokens is not counted as a proof check.

Main asked that the empty sign be provisionally encoded as phi after inspecting the display crop. The other page reader/main will establish cote-wide consistency. No shared notation file was edited by reader B.
Il at the start of the argument is compact and looped; no separate deletion/overwriting state is asserted beyond the explicit unsure reading. C6 does show a local overwritten first capital.

H’s explanatory note written above a struck word is editorial; it is not transcribed. H itemize, bold labels, page markers, and macros are not independent ink. C preceq/H preccurlyeq is treated provisionally as an equivalent symbol rendering.
Pale reverse-side/underlying marks and paper texture were ignored. No archive sheet number distinct from manuscript 26 was identified on this sheet.
